Camila, hello, it's the manager of the credit team. I sent you a request this morning and I want to explain it, because it is not a replacement. It is a new position, and I know the situation this quarter. Here is my justification. In March my team took on the Chile portfolio, and since then the volume of files has grown by about a third. Nobody left, so on paper nothing changed, but in practice one analyst is doing the work of two people. I am not asking for three positions. I am asking for one, and I am asking now because if I wait for January, I lose the two good candidates I have. Please tell me what you need from me and I prepare it today.

Good morning, this is a short message from finance about approvals this quarter. The rule has not changed: new positions are on hold until January. Replacements are still possible, and exceptions exist, but only with two criteria together. First, the role has to be critical, which means the business stops or a legal obligation is not met without it. Second, the cost has to be inside the budget we already approved for the year. If one of the two is missing, the answer is no, and it is better for everybody to hear that in the first week than in the fourth. One request to HR: send me the business justification in three lines and the monthly cost. Three lines are enough. Thank you.
